description: Reads performance analytics. level 'posts' (default) returns per-post metrics (impressions, views, likes, comments, shares, clicks, ...) with totals for a date range or for one post. level 'accounts' returns the latest account-level snapshot (followers, reach, impressions, engagement, ...) per connected account, plus a daily series when from/to are given. Data is synced periodically, so very recent posts may have no metrics yet.

accountIds.description: Limit to these accounts (IDs from autoposter_list_accounts).

from.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive). Default: 14 days before 'to'.

limit.description: Max posts or series rows returned (default 20, max 50). Totals always cover all matches.

platform.description: level 'posts' only: limit to one platform, e.g. 'instagram'.

postId.description: level 'posts' only: return analytics for this post (from autoposter_list_posts).

to.description: End date YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive). Default: today (UTC). Max range 90 days.

name: autoposter_get_analytics

accounts.description: level 'accounts': latest snapshot (and series) per account.

summary.description: level 'posts': post counts and summed metrics over successful rows.

title: Get Analytics
